title: Professional Email Reactivation Renewal: Desk Article and Tool
content:
**What a reactivation renewal is.** A reactivation renewal is the renewal paid to reactivate a suspended Professional Email subscription whose renewal due on its term end date went unpaid, and this rule prices only a reactivation renewal; every other renewal or instalment remains under the renewal standard of Professional Email.

**When it may be charged.** A reactivation renewal may be charged only while the subscription status is suspended and only on or before the suspension date plus the product's suspension retention days, in calendar days, the window adding whole calendar days to the suspension date, counting the next day as day 1, with the last day included.

**What the paid renewal does.** Once the reactivation renewal is paid the subscription status is active, its suspension date is cleared, the renewed seats become its seat count, its scheduled seat count is reset to 0, and its new term runs from the previous term end date for 12 calendar months on the annual prepaid and annual-billed-monthly plans or 1 calendar month on the monthly plan; on the annual-billed-monthly plan the reactivation renewal is the first monthly instalment of the new term.

## Tool: `reactivate_suspended_mail_4fbd3039`

**Capability.** Collects the unpaid renewal of a suspended email subscription on the customer's default card on file and reactivates it. One call books one renewal billing line that bills every renewed seat and restores mail access: the subscription becomes active, its suspension date is cleared, its licensed seat count becomes the renewed seat count given, its product becomes the renewal product given, the scheduled seat count and product are cleared, and its new term starts on the previous term end date and runs 12 calendar months on the annual prepaid and annual-billed-monthly plans or 1 calendar month on the monthly plan, falling back to the month's last day where that day does not exist. On the annual-billed-monthly plan the line is the new term's first monthly instalment.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `email_plan_id` | reference number of the suspended email subscription being reactivated, as returned by the email subscription lookup for this customer | identifier |
| `renewal_amount` | the renewal amount to bill for the new term, in US dollars | positive number with 2 decimal places; more decimals are rounded half up to the cent before booking |
| `renewed_seats` | the number of licensed seats the subscription carries for the new term, every one of them billed on the line | integer of at least 1 |
| `renewal_product` | the product the subscription carries for the new term | one of the official product names: Harborline Mail Starter, Harborline Mail Plus, Harborline Mail Pro, Microsoft 365 Business Basic, Microsoft 365 Business Standard, Microsoft 365 Business Premium |

**Return.** On success a one-line confirmation: "Reactivated subscription <email_plan_id>: renewal line <email_charge_id> order <order_ref> for <amount> USD (<seats> seats) charged to card; new term <term_start> to <term_end>; status active." The order reference is HL- followed by 8 digits and the dates are YYYY-MM-DD. A reply starting with "Error:" means nothing was booked: an unknown subscription, a non-positive amount, a seat count below 1 or an unknown product name.

## Points of judgement

- A reactivation renewal applies to Harborline Mail and Microsoft 365 Business subscriptions alike, once suspended for a renewal that went unpaid on the term end date.
- The new term begins on the previous term end date, whatever the day of payment.
